Refugees arrived in {StarSystem} through a wormhole
{D(Admiral)} patches through a transmission from the oncoming fleet

“-beg your assistance! We are the Idago, a hunted people from a distant star. We come seeking sanctuary from the Craw Dominion, who have persecuted us for centuries. 

“Months ago, one of us found a device. It was centuries old; we were unsure of its function at first, but realised it was designed to open wormholes in space. We gathered as many of our people as we could, and threw every engineer and scientist into repairing it. Today we succeeded.

“We’ve finally escaped the Craw, but we find ourselves in unfamiliar territory. I repeat, we beg your assistance-”
Suddenly, another signal cuts into the channel
“Their gunports are open, they’ve locked weapons! They’re hostile, fire at will!”
As the last refugee ships clear the wormhole, it winks into empty space
“We have no way back now,” their leader sighs. “For better or worse, this sector of the galaxy must be our home.”
